source_units.text: Describe a design concept for imaginary currency.
These invented details are required: The imaginary banknote centers a woven sun, carries nine square windows on its reverse, and uses a violet border.
The sun represents shared work; the windows represent the invented city districts.
Include each of these exact strings: "a woven sun", "nine square windows", "violet border".
Keep the complete piece to 60–90 words.
